top_signals.title: China to Convene Meeting on Supporting Stock Market, Reports Say
top_signals.summary: China’s central bank and its securities regulator will hold a meeting on Monday to discuss the use of tools designed to support the country’s capital market, according to local media.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
